map.路牌、公交候车亭等户外媒体，按日均人/车流量 × 广告牌数量 × 投放天数 ×: For out-of-home media such as road signs and bus shelters, effective reach is estimated from average daily people or vehicle traffic × number of billboards × number of campaign days × notice rate.

map.户外大牌有效触达与 CPM: Effective reach and CPM of a large billboard
map.日均人流量 50000、广告牌 3 块、投放 30 天、注意率 15%。有效触达: Average daily foot traffic 50000, 3 billboards, 30 days, notice rate 15%. Effective reach = 50000×3×30×0.15 = 675000 exposures; with a total campaign cost of 90000 CNY, CPM = 90000 ÷ 675000 × 1000 ≈ 133.3 CNY per thousand.
map.注意率（Recall/Notice Rate）怎么估？: How is the notice rate (Recall/Notice Rate) estimated?
map.来自第三方调研或媒体提供的环境注意系数，通常 5%–20% 不等，受点位视线、遮: It comes from third-party research or the environmental attention coefficient the media provides, usually 5%-20%, affected by sightlines, obstructions and traffic speed. An optimistic estimate overstates reach, so take a conservative value and note its source.
map.CPM 低就一定好？: Is a low CPM always better?
map.不一定。CPM 只反映'千人成本'，还要看人群匹配度（是否是目标客群）与停留环境: Not necessarily. CPM only reflects the cost per thousand people, and you also need audience fit (whether they are your target customers) and the surrounding environment. A prime business district slot has a high CPM but may convert better, so judge it together with backend conversion.
